project: Bellwood Hub — Mayor's AI Chief of Staff
tagline: Graph-augmented, entity-resolved institutional-memory platform over the Village of Bellwood's ~70,000 municipal emails — a queryable chief of staff, not just search.
headline: 🟡 Agents became instructable — 2026-07-18 night session shipped Focus + the one box (configure an agent with one plain-English instruction; the retrieval query is derived from it) and the first agent routed entirely by instruction, a Google Security desk whose first live run on a real mailbox produced 4 cited findings from 0 stream-routed messages. Two silent-failure bugs closed (a backfill that could stall forever while reporting success; an audit ledger that was append-only but anon-readable) and a panel that fabricated "92% recovered" and invented gap cards beside live answers was deleted. On branch agent-focus-and-sync-fixes — pushed, not merged.

rows.t: TASK-10 · Security audit before going live
rows.detail: Full pre-production security audit / penetration test before any real mailbox data goes live — a go-live gate. Scope: adversarial threat model (brief §9 — a sitting official's email: FOIA, opposition research, breach exposure); enforce row-level RBAC via Postgres RLS (currently stubbed — ISS-4); PII detection + tagging at ingestion; encryption in transit + at rest; least-privilege DB roles per pipeline stage; secrets management + key rotation (RSK-1 / TASK-7); the immutable audit trail (ISS-5); NIST 800-53 + CJIS §5.4 control review for the police CJI data; dependency/SCA scan; auth review. Engage municipal counsel on FOIA / Open Meetings / records-retention. Pairs with ISS-5 (audit) and ISS-4 (RLS) — all post-demo.

blocker.text: TASK-13 — verify RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=canonical on bellwood-mayor and the pilot. It defaults to poc, an OpenAI-embedded store that is empty on any stack built from the canonical migrations. The symptom is not an error: Ask returns "0 sources recovered" on every question, and the error text blames a missing OpenAI key. Found on the test stack — the Mayor's app may be failing this way now, independent of the branch merge.

issues.title: Ingest could stall a backfill permanently while reporting success
issues.detail: SELECT-then-INSERT against uq_raw_version. A provider batch can contain the same message twice (Gmail backfill, overlapping pages), so the second copy threw and unwound the whole 400-message round. The cursor only advances after a batch completes, so the next run re-pulled the same page — self-healing only because the duplicate was a race. A deterministic duplicate would loop forever, silently. Fixed: idempotent RAW landing plus per-message isolation; failures are now counted and reported rather than swallowed.

issues.title: app.audit_log was readable by the anon key
issues.detail: 004_audit.sql stopped at REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE — append-only is not private. The table is also absent from 003_rls.sql's array, whose schema-wide revoke ran before 004 created it. The ledger records who read which record plus IP/device/geo. MH-2 hit the same gap and fixed it by hand on the Mayor's DB; now encoded in the migration so it stops recurring on fresh projects.

issues.title: The Ask right rail fabricated metrics beside live answers
issues.detail: RetrievalPlan rendered a hardcoded '92%'; GapsPanel rendered hardcoded demo copy — '2 gaps in this answer', 'Public Works CSV at 78% coverage' — over live answers about a real mailbox. In a product whose promise is that it cites sources and states what is missing, a panel that invents missing things is the worst available bug. Deleted; replaced with the user's own recent searches. The honest no-records note was kept.

issues.detail: 2026-07-18 live run: slice 200, digest 0. Either correct (a personal mailbox has no constituent business) or the uncited-point stripping in agent-runner.ts is too aggressive. Needs a look before the behaviour is trusted on the Mayor's mail.

issues.title: Abstract instructions retrieve noise
issues.detail: Measured on a real mailbox: 'invoices and payment requests' and 'meeting invitations' retrieved precisely; 'anything urgent that needs a reply from me' returned marketing copy. A top-score weak-match warning was built and removed — correct invoices (0.41) and pure junk (0.41) are indistinguishable by score. Mitigated by MIN_SCORE, the preview, and docs/AGENT_TEST_PLAN.md.

issues.title: No audit trail — must meet NIST 800-53 AU + CJIS §5.4 government auditing standards
issues.detail: ⏳ SCHEDULED POST-DEMO (RD, Jun 26) — deferred until after Monday; required before any real mailbox data. CRITICAL go-live blocker (not a demo blocker). STANDARDS: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 'AU' (Audit & Accountability) family is the federal baseline; CJIS Security Policy §5.4 applies because police blotter/incident data is Criminal Justice Information; add HIPAA §164.312(b) audit controls if fire/EMS PHI is indexed; retention per the Illinois Local Records Act. REQUIREMENTS — (1) LOG EVERY EVENT [AU-2/AU-12, CJIS 5.4.1.1]: searches/retrievals (/api/ask), record & document accesses (/api/email = CJI access), agent drafts, approvals/decisions, exports, logins (success+fail), permission and config changes. (2) RECORD CONTENT [AU-3, AU-8, CJIS 5.4.1.1.1]: synchronized timestamp, event type, system component, source (session/IP), actor identity, target (message_id/entity), outcome (success/fail), plus query text + result count. (3) PROTECTION [AU-9, AU-10]: append-only, tamper-evident (hash-chained), immutable — not modifiable or deletable by application roles; non-repudiation. (4) RETENTION [AU-11, CJIS]: at least 365 days, then per the local records schedule. (5) REVIEW & REPORTING [AU-6/AU-7, CJIS 5.4.3]: at-least-weekly review, searchable, exportable reports. IMPLEMENTATION: an append-only audit table + write-through middleware on every API action, written under a protected DB role, with a review/export surface.

risks.title: Agent anxiety — distrust of agents doing unapproved or automated work could block adoption
risks.detail: The biggest adoption risk: the Mayor and staff won't trust a system where agents act on their own. If trust isn't established, the product isn't used. MITIGATION: log every agent action — both human-approved and automated — to a visible, date-sorted Agent Activity page (FEAT-6) that links each action to the agent and its logs, backed by R3 human gates (agents draft, never send unprompted) and the immutable audit trail (ISS-5). Transparency is the trust mechanism.

decisions.text: One instruction box, not four fields. Configuring an agent meant charter + goals + urgency rules + focus — a taxonomy to learn before you could say what you wanted. Now one plain-English box; the old fields survive behind Advanced. The retrieval query is derived from the instruction by one Haiku call at save time, cached, and shown in the preview — never derived in the runner, because reading config must not cost a model call.

Route agents by meaning, not by enum. StreamKey is a closed 7-value union and the topics it switches on are never written on the live path, so live routing runs on sender-domain matching alone. Focus makes an agent's scope a sentence resolved semantically. Proof: the Google Security agent has no StreamKey at all and its first live run produced 4 cited findings. This is the mechanism the per-department fleet should be built on — one sentence per desk, not one enum value + regex + deploy each.

Ask runs on the canonical store; poc is dead. RETRIEVAL_BACKEND defaulted to poc, which is empty on any canonical-built stack, so a fresh instance silently answers '0 sources' and blames a missing OpenAI key. Flipped to canonical. Side effect: Ask no longer needs OpenAI at all — OpenAI now serves only Whisper voice, a narrower compliance entry (query audio, never record content).

North Star: ONE place for the Mayor to look, search, and build his day. The Chief of Staff organizes his inbox, confirms his calendar (agent-supported), powers AI Search, and builds summaries by area. Unifying concept: configurable Area views — e.g., Firehouse (contacts · events · tasks), Police (emails · notices · tasks), Public Works — each a single domain workspace, built up over time (FEAT-3).
Direction: this becomes an agent that connects to other agents (agent-to-agent / MCP) — the capability agents + MCP server are the foundation.

Jobs-to-be-done IA: mobile reorganized around tasks — Emails (queued-to-go + needs-attention), Events (was Commitments), Search, History (was Memory), Source. Renamed throughout; kept "institutional memory" as the brand tagline. Every email is clickable to the full source document.
Kept the JSON demo as the default (DEMO_MODE=1) over the live DB — reliability for the mayor demo.
Connect via the Supabase Session Pooler (IPv4) instead of the direct IPv6 host — no IPv4 add-on needed.
Fixed a latent migration bug (canonical message_topics excluded from the RLS loop — no tenant_id column) so the schema applies cleanly on a fresh DB.
